envelope.description: Cross-chunk relation checks for quality and adherence

body.title: Cross-chunk relation checks for quality and adherence
body.summary: gather.relationCall(pair, maxChars?) for the quality and adherence dimensions judges each 'calls' relation in ChunkPlan.crossRelations: one call carrying both full rows when they fit together, otherwise (or when maxChars is set after a refusal) two calls, one full row against the other's neighbour summary in each direction, each within the size. Each judges whether the caller's use matches the callee (arguments, return use, error contract; for adherence the approved clauses either carries) and returns today's findings shape with a mismatch located at the caller. gather.validate rejects a relation answer naming a counterpart or location outside its two symbols.
acceptanceChecks: A relation call carries both full rows when they fit, else full against neighbour summary in each direction, and every call fits the limit (or the reported maxChars).
A caller and callee in different chunks whose contract disagrees are judged in a relation call and the mismatch is reported at the caller.
A relation answer naming a counterpart outside its two symbols is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.
